info.title: MCP Gateway API
info.description: Enterprise MCP gateway: health, tools list/call, audit query/export, admin reload, admin tenants list, admin tenant API token rotation (`POST /admin/tenants/{tenantId}/rotate`). Auth via API key (X-Api-Key or Bearer) for tenants; admin token for reload, tenant inventory (`GET /admin/tenants`), redacted runtime config (`GET /admin/config` / `adminGetConfig`; **no** secrets), SIEM audit CSV (`GET /admin/audit.csv`), Markdown (`GET /admin/audit.md`), and HTML (`GET /admin/audit.html` / `GET /admin/audit?format=csv|json|md|html`; columns `ts,tenantId,tool,allow,reason,via,requestId`; **no** args/headers/tokens/bodies; empty CSV → header only; empty Markdown → heading + header; empty HTML → heading + “no events”), and cross-tenant audit. In-memory audit ring buffer: default max **10000** events (`--audit-max` / `AUDIT_MAX_EVENTS`; `0` = unlimited, dangerous). Over cap, drop oldest. Live `GET /audit`, `GET /audit/export`, and `GET /admin/audit` (CSV/JSON/Markdown/HTML) see only the retained window; webhook fan-out still posts every new event. Prometheus gauges `audit_events` and `audit_retained`. Optional per-tenant `ipAllowlist` (exact IPv4/IPv6 or IPv4 CIDR /8,/16,/24): client IP from X-Forwarded-For first hop or socket remoteAddress; mismatch → 403 `{error:"forbidden",reason:"ip_denied"}`. Prometheus `GET /metrics` includes `tool_calls_total`, `rate_limited_total`, optional `ip_denied_total`, `http_requests_total`. Optional `maxBodyBytes` (default 1048576; per-tenant override): POST body over limit → 413 `{error:"payload_too_large"}` before JSON parse (Content-Length early or stream count). Prometheus `body_too_large_total`. Optional `cors: { origins: ["*"] or explicit list, methods, headers }`. Default omitted/empty `origins` = no CORS headers (deny). When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a listed Origin → 204 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` / `Allow-Methods` / `Allow-Headers`; unlisted Origin → 403 `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`. Matching GET/POST include ACAO. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` (browser JS can read 503 `Retry-After`). Optional `upstream.timeoutMs` (default 5000): HTTP and stdio upstream calls abort after the timeout. `POST /tools/call` timeout → 504 `{error:"upstream_timeout"}`; Prometheus `upstream_timeout_total`; audit `reason=upstream_timeout`. Optional `X-Request-Id` request header: echoed on **every** response. If omitted or empty, the gateway generates a UUID. The same value is stored as `requestId` on audit JSONL events (`GET /audit`, `GET /audit/export`, CLI `export-audit`) and webhook payloads. Optional gzip on audit export: query `gzip=1|true` or request header `Accept-Encoding: gzip` returns a gzipped body with `Content-Encoding: gzip` and `Content-Disposition` filename ending in `.json.gz` / `.csv.gz`. Explicit `gzip=0` disables compression even if Accept-Encoding includes gzip. Uncompressed JSON/CSV remains the default. CLI: `export-audit --gzip --out out/audit.json.gz`. Optional `upstream.breaker: { failureThreshold: 3, openMs: 2000 }` (omitted/`enabled:false`/threshold 0 = disabled). Consecutive `upstream_timeout` and 5xx/connect errors open the circuit: further `POST /tools/call` to that upstream return **503** `{error:"circuit_open"}` without calling upstream until `openMs` elapses (half-open: one probe). **503** includes `Retry-After` (remaining seconds until `openUntil`, minimum 1). Audit `reason=circuit_open`; Prometheus `circuit_open_total`. When the breaker is enabled, `GET /health` includes `breaker: { state: closed|open|half_open, failures, openUntil }` (ISO-8601 or null; **no secrets**). The `breaker` field is omitted when disabled so liveness stays `{ok:true}`. `GET /health` is liveness: always 200 `{ok:true}` even if the circuit is open. `GET /ready` is readiness: 200 `{ok:true}` when the breaker is disabled or `closed`/`half_open`; 503 `{ok:false, reason:"circuit_open"}` when `state` is `open`. On SIGTERM/SIGINT, 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` wins (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining). When enabled, `/ready` includes the same `breaker` snapshot (no secrets). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. Optional outbound audit webhooks (`policy.webhooks[]`): fire-and-forget POST JSON after audit write (`type`, `source`, `redacted`, `requestId`, `event`). Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still signs the raw body only). Optional per-hook `secret`: when set, POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 of the **raw JSON body**. On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Optional Prometheus `webhook_retries_total`. Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation, and timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. See `AuditWebhook`. Admin tenant API token rotation: `POST /admin/tenants/{tenantId}/rotate` (alias `POST /admin/tenants/rotate` body `{tenantId}`) requires the same admin token as `GET /admin/tenants`. Response `{ok:true, tenantId, token, previousTokenExpiresAt?}` — new key shown once. Previous key remains valid for a grace window (default **60s**, env `TOKEN_ROTATE_GRACE_SEC` / `--rotate-grace-sec`) then is rejected. During grace both keys work. Audit event `type=token_rotated` (**no** raw tokens in JSONL/CSV/logs/metrics labels). Unknown tenant → **404**; unauthenticated → **401**. File-backed policies persist the new `apiKey` (and `previousApiKey` / `previousApiKeyExpiresAt` during grace) the same way existing keys are stored; in-memory-only (no `--config`) keeps rotation in process until restart. Streamable HTTP MVP: `POST /mcp` (alias `POST /`) accepts JSON-RPC 2.0 (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`) with the same tenant API key as `/tools/*`. Echoes `MCP-Protocol-Version` (default `2025-03-26`). Assigns `Mcp-Session-Id` UUID on `initialize` if omitted; later calls may omit the session (backward compatible). **Not** full spec SSE: `GET /mcp` returns **405** `Allow: POST, DELETE`. `DELETE /mcp` with `Mcp-Session-Id` terminates that session (**204**; missing header **400** `{error:"session_id_required"}`; unknown/expired/already gone **404** `{error:"session_not_found"}`). Session id is the capability (no admin token). Idempotent: second DELETE → 404. REST `/tools/*` unchanged. Existing REST `POST /tools/list` and `POST /tools/call` are unchanged. Session TTL default **3600s** (`--session-ttl` / `MCP_SESSION_TTL_SEC`; `0` = no expiry). Unused sessions expire: POST with an expired `Mcp-Session-Id` → **404** `{error:"session_expired"}` (clients should re-initialize). Missing session still allowed; unknown (fresh) ids are accepted and tracked (in-memory last-seen cap **10000**, drop oldest).  REST `/tools/*` ignores session. Admin session inventory: `GET /admin/sessions` (same admin token as `GET /admin/tenants`) lists live in-memory Streamable HTTP sessions `{ok, ttlSec, cap, count, sessions[{id, ageMs, ttlRemainingMs, lastSeen}]}` (newest **100** by lastSeen; `count` is the full live size; `truncated: true` when capped; tombstones/expired omitted; optional `dropped` tombstone count; **no** secrets/API keys/Authorization). `ttlSec` is the configured TTL (`0` = no expiry → `ttlRemainingMs` may be `null`). Unauthenticated → **401**. CORS + `X-Request-Id` like other admin GET. Admin force-drop: `DELETE /admin/sessions/{id}` (`adminDeleteSession`; same admin token; **204**; unknown/expired/already gone **404** `{error:"session_not_found"}`; unauth **401**; id in the path, **no** `Mcp-Session-Id` header). Client `DELETE /mcp` unchanged. GET /admin/config (`adminGetConfig`) redacted runtime config (no secrets). Admin single-tenant GET: `GET /admin/tenants/{tenantId}` (`adminGetTenant`) returns one tenant with `hasApiKey` / `hasPreviousApiKey` / `previousApiKeyExpiresAt` / `allow` / `deny` / `rateLimit` — **never** `apiKey` or `previousApiKey` values. Unknown id → **404** `{error:"tenant_not_found"}`. Admin webhook inventory: `GET /admin/webhooks` (`adminListWebhooks`) returns `{ok, count, webhooks[{id, events, hasUrl, hasSecret}]}` — **never** `url` / `secret` / apiKey / admin token. Empty config → `{ok:true, count:0, webhooks:[]}`. Unauthenticated → **401**.

200.description: Gateway is up. Optional `breaker` snapshot when the circuit breaker is configured/enabled.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.description: Liveness. Always `{ok:true}` when the process is up (circuit open does not flip `ok`). When `upstream.breaker` is enabled, includes `breaker: { state, failures, openUntil }` (no secrets). Omitted when the breaker is disabled.

get.summary: Readiness (503 when circuit open or shutting down)
get.description: Readiness. 200 `{ok:true}` when `upstream.breaker` is disabled or state is `closed`/`half_open`. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"circuit_open"}` when state is `open`. On SIGTERM/SIGINT drain, 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` wins over healthy 200 (and over circuit_open). When the breaker is enabled, includes `breaker: { state, failures, openUntil }` (same snapshot as GET /health; no secrets). Omitted when disabled. Does not consume the half-open probe. Liveness remains `GET /health` (always 200 `{ok:true}` even if the circuit is open; includes `shuttingDown: true` while draining). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks should stay on `/health`.

200.description: Ready. Breaker disabled or closed/half_open. Optional `breaker` snapshot when enabled.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

503.description: Not ready: upstream circuit breaker is open (`reason: circuit_open`, plus `breaker` snapshot when enabled, `Retry-After` remaining seconds until `openUntil`, min 1) **or** process is shutting down (`reason: shutting_down`) after SIGTERM/SIGINT. GET /health stays 200 (`shuttingDown: true` while draining).

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.summary: Prometheus metrics (incl. optional ip_denied_total, body_too_large_total, upstream_timeout_total, circuit_open_total, webhook_retries_total)
get.description: Prometheus text exposition. Counters: `tool_calls_total{tool,decision,tenant}`, `rate_limited_total`, `ip_denied_total` (per-tenant IP allowlist denials; optional / always present at 0), `body_too_large_total` (POST bodies exceeding `maxBodyBytes`; optional / always present at 0), `upstream_timeout_total` (HTTP/stdio upstream aborted after `upstream.timeoutMs`; always present at 0), `circuit_open_total` (tools/call rejected while upstream circuit is open; always present at 0), `webhook_retries_total` (outbound audit webhook POST retries; OSS one retry on 5xx/network/timeout; always present at 0), `http_requests_total{path,status}`. Gauges: `audit_events` and `audit_retained` (in-memory ring length; default cap 10000).

post.summary: List allowed tools for the caller tenant

403.description: Policy deny; or IP allowlist deny (`reason=ip_denied`)

post.description: Call a tool (policy + rate-limit + audit) Body size limited by `maxBodyBytes` (default 1MiB; per-tenant override); over → 413 `payload_too_large`. Upstream proxy abort: `upstream.timeoutMs` (default 5000) on HTTP fetch / stdio RPC; over → 504 `upstream_timeout`. Circuit breaker: `upstream.breaker` `{ failureThreshold, openMs }` (defaults 3 / 2000; omit to disable). Open → 503 `circuit_open` without calling upstream; after `openMs` one half-open probe. 503 includes `Retry-After` (remaining seconds until `openUntil`, min 1).

Alias of /tools/call Body size limited by `maxBodyBytes` (default 1MiB; per-tenant override); over → 413 `payload_too_large`. Upstream proxy abort: `upstream.timeoutMs` (default 5000) on HTTP fetch / stdio RPC; over → 504 `upstream_timeout`. Circuit breaker: `upstream.breaker` `{ failureThreshold, openMs }` (defaults 3 / 2000; omit to disable). Open → 503 `circuit_open` without calling upstream; after `openMs` one half-open probe. 503 includes `Retry-After` (remaining seconds until `openUntil`, min 1).

Minimal Streamable HTTP surface for current MCP clients. POST JSON-RPC 2.0 (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `ping`) on `/mcp` (alias `POST /`). Same tenant API key as `/tools/*` (Bearer or `X-Api-Key`). Echoes `MCP-Protocol-Version` (default `2025-03-26`; client YYYY-MM-DD is echoed when sent). Assigns `Mcp-Session-Id` UUID on `initialize` if the client omitted it; missing session on later `tools/list` / `tools/call` is accepted (backward compatible with REST local-mvp). **Not** a full spec SSE rewrite: GET is 405 `Allow: POST, DELETE`. `DELETE /mcp` terminates a session (see `mcpSessionDelete`). REST `/tools/list` and `/tools/call` unchanged (no session required). Session TTL default **3600s** (`--session-ttl` / `MCP_SESSION_TTL_SEC`; `0` = no expiry). Expired `Mcp-Session-Id` → **404** `{error:"session_expired"}` so clients re-initialize. Missing session still allowed; unknown ids accepted and tracked (cap 10000, drop oldest). Batch JSON-RPC is not supported (400). Notifications (`notifications/*`) return 202 empty.

404.description: Expired `Mcp-Session-Id`. Body `{error:"session_expired"}`. Client should re-initialize. Missing session is still allowed; unknown ids are accepted and tracked. REST `/tools/*` is unaffected.

get.description: Streamable HTTP GET would be SSE in the full spec. This MVP is POST JSON-RPC + DELETE session terminate: returns **405** with `Allow: POST, DELETE` so clients fail fast (no hanging event-stream).

405.description: Method not allowed. Streamable HTTP MVP is POST JSON-RPC or DELETE to terminate a session (no SSE).

Allow.description: Allowed methods for this path (`POST, DELETE`).

delete.description: Terminate the Streamable HTTP session identified by `Mcp-Session-Id`. The session id is the capability — **no** admin token and **no** tenant API key. Success → **204** No Content. Missing header → **400** `{error:"session_id_required"}`. Unknown, expired, or already terminated → **404** `{error:"session_not_found"}` (idempotent). Does not leak whether the id ever existed. TTL still applies independently. REST `/tools/*` unchanged. Optional audit `type=session_deleted` (**no** raw session id or tokens).

404.description: Unknown, expired, or already terminated session. Body `{error:"session_not_found"}`.

403.description: Tenant mismatch; or IP allowlist deny (`reason=ip_denied`)

get.summary: Download audit export pack (JSON or CSV; optional gzip)

parameters.name: gzip
parameters.description: 1|true to gzip the pack. Also honored when Accept-Encoding includes gzip (or x-gzip). Explicit gzip=0 disables compression even if Accept-Encoding: gzip. Default uncompressed.

200.description: Attachment download. Default uncompressed JSON or CSV. With `?gzip=1` or `Accept-Encoding: gzip`: gzipped body, `Content-Encoding: gzip`, filename `.json.gz` / `.csv.gz`.

Content-Encoding.description: Present as `gzip` when the pack is compressed (`?gzip=1` or Accept-Encoding: gzip).

403.description: Tenant mismatch; or IP allowlist deny (`reason=ip_denied`)

post.summary: Hot-reload policy from config path and reconnect upstream

get.summary: List tenants (admin inventory; no raw API keys)
get.description: Admin-token-protected tenant inventory. Returns id, allow/deny counts, rateLimit, hasIpAllowlist, maxBodyBytes, and apiKeyMasked (last 4 only). **Never** returns raw `apiKey`.

Admin-token-protected single-tenant inventory. Complements `GET /admin/tenants` (list) and `POST /admin/tenants/{tenantId}/rotate`. Returns `{ok, id, hasApiKey, hasPreviousApiKey, previousApiKeyExpiresAt, allow, deny, rateLimit, hasIpAllowlist, maxBodyBytes}` from the effective policy. **Never** returns `apiKey` or `previousApiKey` values (booleans + expiry only). Unknown id → **404** `{error:"tenant_not_found"}`. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/tenants`). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.summary: List live Streamable HTTP sessions (admin inventory; no secrets)
get.description: Admin-token-protected inventory of in-memory MCP Streamable HTTP sessions. Returns `{ok, ttlSec, cap, count, sessions}` where `sessions` is up to **100** newest-by-lastSeen (`id`, `ageMs`, `ttlRemainingMs`, `lastSeen` ISO-8601). `count` is the full live size; `truncated: true` when more than 100 exist. Tombstones (deleted/expired ids) are **not** listed; optional `dropped` is the current tombstone count. **Never** includes API keys, Authorization headers, or other secrets. `ttlSec` is the configured TTL (`0` = no expiry → `ttlRemainingMs` may be `null`). Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/tenants`). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET. List-only on this path. Admin force-drop is `DELETE /admin/sessions/{id}` (`adminDeleteSession`; id in the path; **no** `Mcp-Session-Id` header). Client `DELETE /mcp` with `Mcp-Session-Id` stays the capability path.

200.description: Live session inventory (secrets omitted; array capped at 100 newest).

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.
Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

delete.summary: Force-drop a Streamable HTTP session (admin ops kill)
delete.description: Admin-token-protected force-drop of an in-memory MCP Streamable HTTP session. Session id is in the **path** — **no** `Mcp-Session-Id` header (client `DELETE /mcp` with `Mcp-Session-Id` stays the capability path for when the client is present). Same admin token as `GET /admin/tenants`. Success → **204** No Content (session tombstoned; subsequent `POST /mcp` with that id → **404** `{error:"session_not_found"}`). Unknown, expired, or already gone → **404** `{error:"session_not_found"}` (idempotent). Missing id in the path (`DELETE /admin/sessions` or `DELETE /admin/sessions/`) → **404** (router-style). Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin`. Optional audit `type=session_deleted` with `via: admin` (**no** raw session id or tokens). CORS Allow-Methods include DELETE when CORS is enabled. REST `/tools/*` and client `DELETE /mcp` unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Session id to terminate (from `Mcp-Session-Id` / initialize). Missing path segment → 404.

get.description: Admin-token-protected snapshot of **safe** runtime config for pilot debugging: `sessionTtlSec`, `sessionCap` (default 10000), `auditMax`, `rotateGraceSec`, `rateLimit.perMinute`, `cors.origins` (list or `*`), `upstream.timeoutMs` / `upstream.breaker` (threshold / openMs / optional `state`), tenant **count** (not keys), webhook **count** and `hasWebhookSecret` per dest (**never** the secret). **Never** includes `apiKey`, `previousApiKey`, webhook secrets, admin token, Authorization, `--header` values, or tenant tokens. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/tenants`). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.summary: List outbound webhooks (admin inventory; no secrets)
get.description: Admin-token-protected inventory of configured outbound audit webhooks. Returns `{ok, count, webhooks}` where each row is `{id, events, hasUrl, hasSecret}`. `id` is the configured id when present, otherwise the 0-based source index. `events` is the configured event list (or `[]`). `hasUrl` / `hasSecret` are booleans only. **Never** includes `url`, `secret`, apiKey, previousApiKey, admin token, Authorization, `--header` values, tenant tokens, or request bodies. Empty / omitted `webhooks` → `{ok:true, count:0, webhooks:[]}`. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/tenants`; tenant API keys are rejected). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET.

200.description: Redacted webhook inventory (urls and secrets omitted).

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.
Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.description: Admin-token-protected audit CSV for SIEM/spreadsheet archive. Columns `ts,tenantId,tool,allow,reason,via,requestId` from JSONL (same fields as `AuditEvent` minus `arguments`/`result`/`argumentKeysHash`). **Never** includes raw args, headers, tokens, or bodies. Live snapshot is the in-memory retained window (default max 10000; `--audit-max` / `AUDIT_MAX_EVENTS`; over cap drops oldest). Empty log → header-only **200**. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/tenants`). Uncompressed `text/csv; charset=utf-8`. Gzip JSON/CSV packs remain on `GET /audit/export`. Alias: `GET /admin/audit?format=csv`. Markdown: `GET /admin/audit.md` / `?format=md`. HTML: `GET /admin/audit.html` / `?format=html`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET.

200.description: CSV audit snapshot (header + rows; header only when empty). No arguments/result/tokens.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.description: Admin-token-protected GitHub-flavored Markdown table for ops docs (Feishu/WeCom/Slack). Heading `# Audit` plus columns `ts | tenantId | tool | allow | reason | via | requestId` (same fields as `GET /admin/audit.csv`). `|` in cells is escaped. **Never** includes raw args, headers, tokens, or bodies. Live snapshot is the in-memory retained window (default max 10000; `--audit-max` / `AUDIT_MAX_EVENTS`; over cap drops oldest). Empty log → heading + header row only, **200**. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/audit.csv`). Uncompressed `text/markdown; charset=utf-8`. Gzip JSON/CSV packs remain on `GET /audit/export`. Alias: `GET /admin/audit?format=md`. HTML: `GET /admin/audit.html` / `?format=html`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET.

200.description: Markdown audit snapshot (heading + GFM table; heading + header only when empty). No arguments/result/tokens.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.description: Admin-token-protected self-contained HTML audit table for the local 5-min demo (no CDN / external CSS/JS). Heading `Audit` plus columns `ts`, `tenantId`, `tool`, `allow`, `reason`, `via`, `requestId` (same fields as `GET /admin/audit.csv`). All text escaped (`& < > " '`). Deny vs allow rows are visually distinct (inline CSS). **Never** includes raw args, headers, tokens, or bodies. Live snapshot is the in-memory retained window (default max 10000; `--audit-max` / `AUDIT_MAX_EVENTS`; over cap drops oldest). Empty log → heading + “no events” + header row, **200**. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin` (same gate as `GET /admin/audit.csv`). Uncompressed `text/html; charset=utf-8`. Gzip JSON/CSV packs remain on `GET /audit/export`. Alias: `GET /admin/audit?format=html`. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other admin GET.

200.description: HTML audit snapshot (heading + table; heading + “no events” when empty). No arguments/result/tokens.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches policy.cors.origins. Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

get.summary: Admin audit snapshot (json | csv | md | html)
get.description: Admin-token-protected audit snapshot. Query `format=json` (default) is an uncompressed JSON pack (`ok`, `format`, `count`, `events`) — does **not** use `Accept-Encoding: gzip` (gzip stays on `GET /audit/export`). `format=csv` is the same SIEM-safe `text/csv` body as `GET /admin/audit.csv` (no args/tokens). `format=md` is the same `text/markdown` body as `GET /admin/audit.md` (`# Audit` GFM table; no args/tokens). `format=html` is the same `text/html` body as `GET /admin/audit.html` (self-contained table; no CDN; no args/tokens). Unknown format → **400** `unsupported_format`. Unauthenticated → **401** `unauthorized_admin`.

parameters.name: redact
parameters.description: JSON only: 1|true to redact arguments/result. CSV never includes those fields.

200.description: Audit snapshot in the requested format

400.description: Unsupported format or invalid since/until. Body `{error:"unsupported_format"}`.

post.summary: Rotate a tenant API token (admin; new token shown once)
post.description: Admin-token-protected tenant API key rotation. Replaces `tenants[].apiKey` in the same policy store. The new token is returned **once** in `{ok:true, tenantId, token, previousTokenExpiresAt?}`. The previous key remains valid until `previousTokenExpiresAt` (default grace **60s**, `TOKEN_ROTATE_GRACE_SEC` / `--rotate-grace-sec`; `0` = immediate). During grace both keys authenticate; after grace only the new key. Writes audit JSONL `{type:"token_rotated", tenantId, requestId}` — **never** raw tokens. File-backed `--config` persists the new `apiKey` (and previous key + expiry during grace) the same way existing keys are stored. In-memory-only (no config path) keeps rotation until restart. Unknown tenant → 404 `{error:"unknown_tenant"}`. Missing/invalid admin token → 401 `{error:"unauthorized_admin"}` (same gate as `GET /admin/tenants`). Alias: `POST /admin/tenants/rotate` with body `{tenantId}`.

200.description: New token (shown once). previousTokenExpiresAt is ISO-8601 when a previous key existed.

post.summary: Rotate a tenant API token (admin; body tenantId)
post.description: Alias of `POST /admin/tenants/{tenantId}/rotate`. Body `{tenantId}` (or `{id}`). Same admin auth, grace window, audit, and persist rules. New token shown once. **Never** logs or audits the raw token.

BearerAuth.description: Tenant API key as Bearer token (also accepted for admin when value matches adminToken)

AdminToken.name: X-Admin-Token
AdminToken.description: Admin token for reload, GET /admin/tenants, GET /admin/tenants/{tenantId}, GET /admin/sessions, DELETE /admin/sessions/{id}, POST /admin/tenants/{tenantId}/rotate, GET /admin/audit.csv, GET /admin/audit.md, GET /admin/config, GET /admin/webhooks, and cross-tenant audit/export

TenantIpAllowlist.description: Optional per-tenant client IP allowlist. Exact IPv4/IPv6 or IPv4 CIDR with prefix /8, /16, or /24. IPv6 exact match only. Absent or empty = no IP restriction. Client IP = X-Forwarded-For first hop or socket remoteAddress.

MaxBodyBytes.description: Max HTTP request body size in bytes for POST /tools/call (and alias). Global policy `maxBodyBytes` (default 1048576); optional per-tenant override. Enforced by Content-Length check and streaming byte count before JSON.parse. Over limit → 413 `{error:"payload_too_large"}`.

TenantSummary.description: Admin-safe tenant inventory row. Raw apiKey is never returned; apiKeyMasked shows only the last 4 characters.

allowCount.description: Number of tools in effective allow list

denyCount.description: Number of tools in effective deny list

apiKeyMasked.description: API key with only last 4 characters visible (e.g. ********_dev). Never the raw key.

CorsConfig.description: Optional CORS. Default omitted or empty `origins` = no extra CORS headers (deny all). `origins` may be `["*"]` (any Origin) or an explicit list. When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a non-listed Origin returns 403 `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`; allowed Origin → 204 with ACAO/ACAM/ACAH. Matching GET/POST/DELETE get Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` (plus `X-Audit-Count`, `X-Audit-Redacted`, `Content-Disposition`). local-mvp uses `["http://localhost:3000"]`. Default allow/expose also includes `MCP-Protocol-Version` and `Mcp-Session-Id` for Streamable HTTP browser clients.

origins.description: `["*"]` or explicit origins. Empty/omitted disables CORS.

headers.description: Access-Control-Allow-Headers (default Content-Type, Authorization, X-Api-Key, X-Admin-Token, X-Request-Id, MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Session-Id)

exposeHeaders.description: Access-Control-Expose-Headers (default includes Retry-After, X-Request-Id, MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Session-Id)

UpstreamConfig.description: Optional upstream MCP proxy. `timeoutMs` (default 5000) aborts HTTP fetch and stdio JSON-RPC. Timeout on POST /tools/call → 504 `{error:"upstream_timeout"}`. Optional `breaker: { failureThreshold: 3, openMs: 2000 }` (omit / `enabled:false` / threshold 0 = disabled). Consecutive timeout and 5xx/connect errors open the circuit → 503 `{error:"circuit_open"}` until `openMs` (half-open: one probe). 503 includes `Retry-After` (remaining seconds until `openUntil`, min 1). When enabled, GET /health includes a `breaker` snapshot (`state`, `failures`, `openUntil`; no secrets).

timeoutMs.description: Abort HTTP/stdio upstream calls after this many milliseconds (default 5000). Timeout → 504 `{error:"upstream_timeout"}`.

breaker.description: Optional consecutive-failure circuit breaker. Omitted, `enabled: false`, or `failureThreshold: 0` disables (existing timeout/proxy proves). Defaults when present: failureThreshold 3, openMs 2000. Failures: `upstream_timeout`, HTTP 5xx, connect errors. Open → 503 `{error:"circuit_open"}` without calling upstream; `Retry-After` is remaining seconds until `openUntil` (min 1). After openMs, half-open allows one probe. When enabled, GET /health includes `breaker: { state, failures, openUntil }` (no secrets).

enabled.description: Set false to disable even if the object is present

openMs.description: Milliseconds to stay open before a half-open probe (default 2000).

Health.description: GET /health body. `ok` is always true while the process is up. `breaker` is present only when `upstream.breaker` is enabled (no secrets).

breaker.description: Present when `upstream.breaker` is enabled. Omitted when disabled. Snapshot only: state, consecutive failures, and openUntil. Never includes keys, tokens, URLs, or config secrets.

shuttingDown.description: Present and true while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Omitted otherwise so stack-demo /health is unchanged.

Ready.description: GET /ready body. 200 `{ok:true}` when the breaker is disabled or `closed`/`half_open`. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"circuit_open"}` when `state` is `open`. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT (wins over healthy 200). `breaker` is present only when `upstream.breaker` is enabled (same snapshot as GET /health; no secrets).

reason.description: Present on 503: `circuit_open` when the breaker is open; `shutting_down` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT.

breaker.description: Present when `upstream.breaker` is enabled. Omitted when disabled. Snapshot only: state, consecutive failures, and openUntil. Never includes keys, tokens, URLs, or config secrets.

CircuitBreakerSnapshot.description: Circuit-breaker snapshot on GET /health and GET /ready when enabled. `state` is closed, open, or half_open. `openUntil` is an ISO-8601 instant while open (when the breaker will enter half-open); null when closed or half_open. No secrets.

state.description: closed = calls pass; open = fail fast 503; half_open = one probe allowed

openUntil.description: ISO-8601 instant when an open circuit will enter half-open. Null when closed or half_open.

AuditEvent.description: JSONL audit row. `requestId` is the resolved `X-Request-Id` (incoming or generated UUID).

requestId.description: Resolved X-Request-Id for the originating HTTP request

type.description: Present on non-tool-call rows. `token_rotated` is written on admin rotate — never includes raw tokens/apiKeys.

AuditWebhook.description: Outbound fire-and-forget POST body after an audit JSONL write. Configure `policy.webhooks: [{ url, events, secret }]`. `events` defaults to `["tool_call","deny"]`. Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still signs the raw body only). When `secret` is set, the POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw JSON body). Short timeout; errors never fail `/tools/call`. OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms on 5xx or network/timeout (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation / timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. Not an inbound HTTP path.

type.description: tool_call when allow=true; deny when allow=false (including rate-limit).

redacted.description: True when arguments/result were redacted (`webhooksRedact` default true).

requestId.description: Resolved X-Request-Id of the originating HTTP request.

event.description: Audit row (redacted when webhooksRedact / redactOnWrite / export.redactDefault).

WebhookEndpoint.description: Policy `webhooks[]` entry. `url` required. `events` optional (default tool_call+deny). `secret` optional: when set, outbound POST is signed with HMAC-SHA256 (`X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` of the raw body). Empty/omitted secret = unsigned. Timestamp header is always sent; HMAC still signs body only. OSS: one retry after ~50ms on 5xx/network/timeout; 4xx do not retry. Exponential backoff / queues = paid.

secret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 key. When set, POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` of the raw JSON body. HMAC still signs body only; `X-Webhook-Timestamp` is an extra header. Simple HMAC is OSS; key rotation / timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later.

TenantRotateResponse.description: Admin rotate result. `token` is the new tenant API key, returned once. Never written to audit JSONL/CSV, access logs, or metrics labels. `previousTokenExpiresAt` is when the previous key stops being accepted (omit if there was no previous key).

token.description: New tenant API key. Shown once. Treat as a secret.

previousTokenExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 instant when the previous key is rejected. During grace both keys work. Default grace 60s.

JsonRpcRequest.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request. Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping. Notifications omit id.

JsonRpcResponse.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response. initialize result includes protocolVersion, serverInfo, sessionId.

SessionInventoryRow.description: Live Streamable HTTP session. No secrets, API keys, or Authorization headers.

ttlRemainingMs.description: Milliseconds until TTL expiry. `null` when ttlSec is 0 (no expiry).

SessionInventory.description: Admin inventory of live in-memory Streamable HTTP sessions. Tombstones omitted. No secrets.

ttlSec.description: Configured session TTL in seconds (`--session-ttl` / MCP_SESSION_TTL_SEC). 0 = no expiry.

count.description: Full live session count (not the truncated array length).

sessions.description: Up to 100 newest-by-lastSeen live sessions. Tombstones and expired ids omitted.

truncated.description: true when count > 100 and the sessions array was capped.

dropped.description: Current tombstone (deleted id) count. Not listed in sessions.

AdminRuntimeConfigRateLimit.description: Global tool-call rate limit (per minute). No secrets.

AdminRuntimeConfigCors.description: CORS origins only (list or `*`). Allow-header **values** are omitted.

origins.description: `*` when any Origin is allowed; otherwise an explicit list. Empty array when CORS is disabled.

AdminRuntimeConfigBreaker.description: Resolved circuit-breaker config + optional live `state`. No secrets.

AdminRuntimeConfigUpstream.description: Safe upstream knobs only. Omits baseUrl, command, args, and `--header` values.

AdminRuntimeConfigTenants.description: Tenant **count** only — never ids, apiKeys, or tokens.

AdminRuntimeConfigWebhookDest.description: Whether HMAC is configured for this dest. **Never** the secret or URL.

hasWebhookSecret.description: true when webhooks[].secret is set. The secret itself is never returned.

AdminRuntimeConfigWebhooks.description: Webhook dest count + HMAC configured flag. No secrets/URLs.

AdminRuntimeConfig.description: Redacted runtime config for GET /admin/config. Allowlist of safe fields only. Never apiKey, previousApiKey, webhook secrets, admin token, Authorization, or `--header` values.

sessionTtlSec.description: Configured Streamable HTTP session TTL (`--session-ttl` / MCP_SESSION_TTL_SEC). 0 = no expiry.

auditMax.description: In-memory audit ring cap (`--audit-max` / AUDIT_MAX_EVENTS). 0 = unlimited.

rotateGraceSec.description: Tenant API key rotate grace (`--rotate-grace-sec` / TOKEN_ROTATE_GRACE_SEC). Default 60.

WebhookInventoryRow.description: One configured outbound webhook. url and secret are never returned; hasUrl / hasSecret are booleans. id is the configured id or 0-based index.

id.description: Configured webhook id when present; otherwise the 0-based source index.

hasUrl.description: True when webhooks[].url is a non-empty string. The URL itself is never returned.

hasSecret.description: True when webhooks[].secret is a non-empty string. The secret itself is never returned.

WebhookInventory.description: Redacted outbound webhook inventory for GET /admin/webhooks. Allowlist of safe fields only. Never url, secret, apiKey, admin token, Authorization, or `--header` values.

count.description: Number of configured webhook entries in this response.

TenantDetail.description: Admin-safe single tenant for GET /admin/tenants/{tenantId}. Raw apiKey / previousApiKey are never returned; hasApiKey / hasPreviousApiKey are booleans. previousApiKeyExpiresAt is the grace expiry (ISO-8601) or null.

hasApiKey.description: True when tenant.apiKey is a non-empty string. The value is never returned.

hasPreviousApiKey.description: True when tenant.previousApiKey is stored (grace window). The value is never returned.

previousApiKeyExpiresAt.description: When the previous key stops being accepted. null when no previous key.

allow.description: Effective allow list (tenant override or global).

deny.description: Effective deny list (tenant override or global).

Unauthorized.description: Missing or unknown API key / admin token

ForbiddenIp.description: Client IP not in tenant ipAllowlist

ForbiddenCors.description: OPTIONS preflight Origin not in policy.cors.origins (explicit list)

UpstreamTimeout.description: Upstream HTTP/stdio call aborted after `upstream.timeoutMs` (default 5000). Audit event `reason=upstream_timeout`; Prometheus `upstream_timeout_total`.

CircuitOpen.description: Upstream circuit breaker is open. `POST /tools/call` returns 503 `{error:"circuit_open"}` without calling upstream until `upstream.breaker.openMs` elapses (then one half-open probe). `Retry-After` is remaining seconds until `openUntil` (minimum 1). Triggered after `failureThreshold` consecutive upstream_timeout / 5xx / connect errors. Audit `reason=circuit_open`; Prometheus `circuit_open_total`.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional correlation id. Echoed on every response as `X-Request-Id`. If omitted/empty, the gateway generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). Also stored as `requestId` on audit JSONL events and webhook payloads.

McpProtocolVersion.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
McpProtocolVersion.description: MCP protocol version. Echoed on Streamable HTTP responses. If omitted or not YYYY-MM-DD, the gateway uses `2025-03-26`.

McpSessionId.name: Mcp-Session-Id
McpSessionId.description: Optional MCP session id. Echoed when present. On `initialize`, a UUID is assigned if omitted. Later JSON-RPC calls may omit it (backward compatible). Expired ids return **404** `{error:"session_expired"}` (TTL default 3600s; `--session-ttl` / `MCP_SESSION_TTL_SEC`; `0` = no expiry). Unknown (fresh) ids are accepted and tracked. `DELETE /mcp` requires this header (400 `session_id_required` if missing; 404 `session_not_found` if unknown/expired/already gone). Not required on REST `/tools/*`.

XRequestId.description: Echo of incoming `X-Request-Id`, or a generated UUID when the request header is omitted/empty. Present on every response.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying while the upstream circuit is open (`POST /tools/call` 503 and `GET /ready` 503). Remaining time until `openUntil` (ISO-8601 on GET /health and GET /ready), rounded up, minimum 1.

McpProtocolVersion.description: Echo of incoming `MCP-Protocol-Version`, or `2025-03-26` when omitted.

McpSessionId.description: Session id: echoed from the request, or a generated UUID on `initialize` when omitted. Not required on subsequent tools/list or tools/call. Omitted on **404** `session_expired`.
